async def run(items, groups, read):
    # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
    five = [await read(x) for x in items if x if x > 1 if x > 2 if x > 3 if x > 4]
    # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
    seven = [await read(x) for x in items if x if x > 1 if x > 2 if x > 3 if x > 4 if x > 5 if x > 6]
    # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
    nested = [await read(x) for group in groups for x in group if x if x > 1 if x > 2]
    once = [x for x in await read() if x if x > 1]
    literal = [await read()]
